welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: HelpNearby makes it easier to request community help in Muscat Governorate. This short guide shows how to create a request and follow it.

request.title: Create a help request
request.body: Open Help Requests from the menu, or choose Request Help on the home page. Select one or more visible services, confirm the location and address, and submit the request. You can add a description if you want.

location.title: Choose the location
location.body: The map shows Muscat Governorate. Choose a point inside the approved boundary. Use your current location, or pick the point yourself on the map if the browser cannot provide it. Before submitting, select the wilayat and enter the neighborhood, street, building number, and landmark, then confirm the location and address.

tracking.title: Follow your request
tracking.body: After you submit, the request stays pending and is visible to approved volunteers whose skills match it. A volunteer can accept it, start helping, and later mark it completed. You can cancel your own request while it is still pending. If nobody accepts it, the request stays saved. Help is not guaranteed and does not arrive at a fixed time.

feedback.title: Rate the help
feedback.body: After the request is completed, open it and choose Give Feedback. Select a rating from 1 to 5 and add a comment. Feedback can be sent once for each completed request.
